descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
What Awaits You
Being a passionate Platform engineer, you care about defining tech stack for business applications together with our team of software architects
Build and evolve a cloud-native platform running on Azure, serving multiple product teams
Design and maintain Kubernetes-based infrastructure
Develop and extend the platform operator - a custom Kubernetes operator that manages application lifecycle, status reporting, error handling, and reconciliation logic
Author and maintain Helm charts and Terraform modules for provisioning Azure resources
Work on the sidecar architecture - configure routing, CORS, proxy ports, path rewrites, external service integration, and direct responses
Contribute and operate to the authentication and authorization layer
Contribute and maintain the observability stack, Grafana-based
Maintain and extend Azure resource modules and Azure Storage Account provisioning
Develop and improve the App Catalog - an internal service registry with frontend and backend components, statistics, mail notifications, and automated update jobs
Enable and maintain schema-driven configuration handbooks, onboarding automation, and application scaffolding
Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge sharing sessions, and platform-wide improvements across multiple product teams
Working in an Agile team using Scrum methodology and their derivatives (SaFE, LeSS) Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and other Agile/Scrum ceremonies to ensure high-quality deliverables and on-time project completion
End-to-end responsibility for application development
Stay updated with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices to continuously improve skills and contribute to the team's success
 What Should You Bring Along
University Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business or a related field
Minimum of 7 years of experience in a similar role is required
Advanced knowledge of OOP, Algorithms & Data Structures
Solid experience with Kubernetes
Hands-on experience with Azure cloud services, particularly:
Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server (including backup/restore strategies)
Azure Storage Accounts
Azure resource provisioning and management across multiple environments
Strong proficiency in Terraform for Infrastructure as Code
Experience with Helm charts
Solid understanding of GitOps principles and deployment workflows (e.g., ArgoCD, Flux, or GitHub Actions-based GitOps)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, ideally GitHub Actions
Good understanding of networking and proxy configuration
Experience with authentication and authorization flows
Familiarity with observability and telemetry*stacks: Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, Tempo
Nice to have:
Experience in development with Java SE 17+
Experience with operator patterns in Kubernetes (custom controllers, reconciliation logic, error handling)
Good understanding of software design principles, design patterns, and best practices
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Excellent English verbal and written skills
German communication skills will be a plus
 What do we offer?
Challenging projects with which we are shaping the mobility of tomorrow
Great team spirit within an international team
State-of-the-art global IT landscape and processes
100% implementation of the Agile Working Model methodology
Wide range of personal & professional development opportunities
High level of job security
Work-Life-Balance and flexible working hours
